title: Wayfare Pass Membership Terms — Ending a Membership and Refunding Fees
content:
# Ending a membership and refunding fees (Wayfare Pass)

## Terms in force

**1. The member's decisions.** Turning auto-renew off and ending a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership at once are the member's own decisions and are made by the member. Turning auto-renew off keeps every benefit to the end of the period in force, and it can be turned back on any time before the period ends.

**2. Refundable statuses.** A fee refund is made only on a membership that is active, past due, paused, pending cancellation or cancelled. The membership's status on record decides, before the refund is made.

**3. Pro rata refund of an annual fee.** When the full refund does not apply, an annual plan whose terms provide a pro rata refund of the annual fee, and that the member ends at once, is refunded the membership fee multiplied by the unused whole months and divided by the period length in calendar months, less the Pass ride credit earned in the period where the plan's terms deduct that credit; a result below the plan's smallest pro rata refund is not paid. The amount is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.
- *Unused whole months* are the whole calendar months of the period in force, counted from the period start's day-of-month, that begin after the cancellation date.
- *Pass ride credit earned in the period* is the credit earned on the membership for the period in force, less credit of that period forfeited because its trip was refunded.

**4. No refund.** Monthly plans are not refunded outside the full refund window, a member who only turns auto-renew off is never refunded, and a membership taken out through a card partner offer is never refunded by Wayfare.

**5. Duplicates.** A duplicate fee charge is always refunded in full regardless of these windows.

**6. One refund per fee charge.** One refund per fee charge; the refund names the charge it returns. Refunds already on the membership ledger naming the same charge decide whether one has been made.

## Retired terms

> **Former term A.** A fee charge was refunded in full only when the member ended the membership within the full refund window, counted in calendar days from the date of the fee charge, day 1 being the calendar day after the charge, with the membership ended no later than the last day of the window.

> **Former term B.** The full refund also required that no benefit was used since that charge: no Pass ride credit earned, no Pass fee waiver and no member discount on the member's trips from the date of that charge through the current day.

Former terms A and B are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded.

## Status movements

| From | Member's act or event | To |
|---|---|---|
| active | the member turns auto-renew off | pending cancellation, benefits continue |
| pending cancellation | the member turns auto-renew back on before the period ends | active |
| pending cancellation | the period in force ends with auto-renew off | cancelled, the day after the period's last day |
| active, trial, paused or pending cancellation | the member ends the membership at once | cancelled on that date |

## Worked example of term 3 (hypothetical inputs)

Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, fee 199.00, period starting 10 January, ended at once on 25 April, with 23.40 of Pass ride credit earned in the period. Months of the period begin on the 10th; those beginning after 25 April are 10 May through 10 December, 8 whole months. 199.00 multiplied by 8 and divided by 12 is 132.6667; less 23.40 gives 109.2667, rounded to 109.27. That is not below 5.00, so 109.27 is paid.

superseded_clauses: A fee charge is refunded in full only when the member ends the membership within the full refund window: The full refund window is counted in calendar days from the event_date of the fee charge: day 1 is the calendar day after the charge, and the membership must be ended no later than the last day of the window.
The full refund also requires that no benefit was used since that charge (pass_msr_benefit_uses_since_charge is 0).
